raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Longitudinal width of the two fixed bottom strips",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The shaded supports span the beam depth, but their widths along the beam are not dimensioned.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix full-depth bottom strips extending 9 mm inward from each longitudinal end.",
        "Fix full-depth bottom strips extending 12 mm inward from each longitudinal end."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 5.4; Fig. 9(a) schematic and caption stating that the bottom sides are fixed."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Footprint of the uniform top-center load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The arrows indicate loading across the depth at midspan, but do not distinguish a transverse line from a finite-width contact strip.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform downward line load across the full depth at longitudinal midspan.",
        "Uniform downward pressure on a full-depth top strip extending 3 mm to either side of longitudinal midspan."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 9(a) arrows and caption: force uniformly applied at the center of the beam top; Sec. 5.4."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Total resultant of the top load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical load magnitude is specified for the optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Total downward resultant of 1 N.",
        "Total downward resultant of 100 N."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 5.4 and Fig. 9(a); Eq. (27) introduces F without assigning its magnitude."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Young's modulus for the isotropic rebuild",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The beam's base-material stiffness magnitude is not supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Young's modulus E = 1 MPa.",
        "Young's modulus E = 1000 MPa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.3 introduces the base-material tensor C* symbolically; Sec. 5.4 supplies no elastic constants."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson ratio for the isotropic rebuild",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson ratio is specified from which to define the benchmark's isotropic material.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson ratio nu = 0.30.",
        "Poisson ratio nu = 0.35."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Secs. 4.3 and 5.4; neither the symbolic material tensors nor the beam example provide a Poisson ratio."
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Minimum admissible local relative density rho_min",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The lower density bound is not assigned numerically. The plotted color scale begins at 0.2, but its relationship to the optimization bound is unstated.",
      "readings": [
        "rho_min = 0.2, interpreting the color-scale endpoint as the prescribed lower bound.",
        "rho_min = 0.001, interpreting 0.2 as a display endpoint rather than an admissibility bound."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Eq. (27) density bounds; attached Fig. 9 density-field image with color scale from 0.2 to 0.8."
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Maximum admissible local relative density rho_max",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The upper density bound is not assigned numerically. The plotted color scale ends at 0.8, without identifying this as a prescribed bound.",
      "readings": [
        "rho_max = 0.8, interpreting the color-scale endpoint as the prescribed upper bound.",
        "rho_max = 1.0, interpreting 0.8 as a display endpoint rather than an admissibility bound."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Eq. (27) density bounds; attached Fig. 9 density-field image with color scale from 0.2 to 0.8."
    }
  ]
}
